q1.question: Do I need a credit card to start?
q1.answer: No. Your 14-day free trial starts immediately after registration — no payment details required.

q2.question: What happens after my trial ends?
q2.answer: You can still log in, view your dashboard, reports, profile and settings. Creating new sales, purchases, inventory changes, expenses and stock transfers is paused until you upgrade.

q3.question: Can I use Clix for more than one branch?
q3.answer: Yes — Clix is built for multi-branch businesses from day one, with role-based access per branch.

q4.question: Is my data safe?
q4.answer: Your business's data is fully isolated from every other company on Clix, with bank-grade encryption in transit.

q5.question: Is Clix available in Kiswahili?
q5.answer: Yes — the entire system, including receipts and reports, works in both English and Kiswahili.
